memory_update.text: ASX should be retained as the US-listed ADR reference benchmark for OSAT advanced packaging/test capacity, but not treated as the core underfollowed alpha candidate due to scale and higher visibility.
AMKR is the cleanest US-listed OSAT candidate for HBM-adjacent backend packaging/test overflow, but direct AI/HBM revenue evidence needs verification through filings and management commentary.

Direct evidence that HBM producers are outsourcing incremental conventional memory backend work to US-listed OSATs remains incomplete; this is the key falsification checkpoint for the overflow thesis.
